title: HKC Quantum70 · V4 menu map
baseline: Quantum70 V4.0+ · installation manual 310118_1; UK options. Earlier official 160811_1 user guide is separately scoped.
scope: Full documented engineer overview and its expanded named branches, User/Manager lists, and a separate authorised inhibit context. Interactive fields/actions coexist with visible hardware and evidence gaps.

sources.title: Quantum 70 Installation Manual
sources.publisher: HKC Ltd.; original manufacturer manual hosted by GARD Security

sources.title: Quantum 70 User Manual
sources.publisher: HKC Security; official GB support download
sources.scope: Earlier Quantum70 user procedures. The V4 installer p57 independently corroborates User/Manager menu order; exact V4 user prompt timing still requires hardware verification.

numbering.style: Immediate local digits for unambiguous numbered menus; unnumbered user lists scroll.
numbering.explanation: Installer p8 explicitly gives keys 31 from the main menu to reach Zone Names. Thus 3 then 1 descends without invented intermediate YES presses. YES selects a scrolled entry and accepts appropriate fields; * and # scroll.
caveats: User/Manager entries have no numeric shortcuts.
Arming Options 1/10/11 is scroll-only pending key-entry verification.
Point5/6, RF CO and IP Monitoring details retain conflicts.
Remote User Phones is953 in V4; retired preV3.2 options are not editable.

navigation.action: Enter/enable; disable an option. Individual field exceptions are noted.
